# Read the lien waiver before you give up your lien.

> Free lien waiver checker for contractors and suppliers: paste the waiver you were sent and see what to fix before you sign, such as an unconditional waiver before the check clears, a release of all claims or future work, a wrong amount or through-date, or retainage not excepted. Private, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
